# Infynix Solutions (United Arab Emirates)

> Infynix Solutions is a Growth Engineering company: three divisions that build the marketing, media and business systems a company needs to attract, convert and scale. This file describes the United Arab Emirates site at https://www.infynixsolutions.ae.

## Business
- Legal name: Infynix Solutions
- Office: C1 Building - Office C1 1F-SF6540, Free Zone, Al Butain, Ajman, AE
- Telephone: +971 54 257 5702
- Email: office@infynixsolutions.ae
- Areas served: United Arab Emirates, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, United Kingdom, India
- Contact page: https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/contact

## Divisions
### Infynix Agency (Performance and digital marketing)
Paid media, search, social and the measurement underneath them. The side of the business that creates demand and proves where it came from.
- Hub: https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/infynix-agency
- [Social Media Management](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/social-media-management): Building active social profiles and brand authority on social channels.
- [Marketing Automation & CRM](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/marketing-automation-crm): Automating lead follow-ups, email drips, and CRM synchronization.
- [UI/UX Design & Brand Styling](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/ui-ux-design): We design digital product layouts and visual brand styles that look modern and guide users to buy.
- [Analytics & Reporting](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/analytics-reporting): Custom analytics dashboards and reporting systems that turn your data into clear, actionable business intelligence.
- [Brand Strategy & Positioning](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/brand-strategy-positioning): Clear brand strategy and market positioning for UAE businesses, defining who you are, who you serve, and why they should choose you.
- [SEO Services & Search Infrastructure](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/seo-services): We engineer technical search pre-rendering, clean HTML tags, and keyword content to help your business rank at the top of search engine results.
- [Performance Marketing & Paid Ads](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/performance-marketing): We manage targeted ad campaigns on Google, Meta, and LinkedIn focused on customer acquisition and return on ad spend.

### Infynix Growth Solutions (Software, ERP and business systems)
Custom web applications, CRM and ERP development, business automation, cloud infrastructure and AI vision systems. The engineering practice.
- Hub: https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/infynix-growth-solutions
- [AI Surveillance & Security Solutions](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/ai-surveillance): Real-time AI computer vision security, local edge processing, and automated threat alerts for commercial facilities.
- [Website Development Services](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/website-development): We build fast, secure web platforms using React 19 and Next.js designed to convert visitors into clients.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/mobile-app-development): We develop custom mobile applications for iOS and Android built for speed, offline usability, and clear navigation.
- [Artificial Intelligence & AI Integration](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/artificial-intelligence): We build custom AI agents and workflow tools that automate daily administrative tasks.
- [Business Automation Solutions](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/business-automation): We connect your software tools with automated APIs so your team spends zero time copying data by hand.
- [Custom CRM & ERP Software](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/crm-erp-development): We build custom CRM and business management software designed around how your company actually operates.
- [Cloud Infrastructure & Hosting](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/cloud-solutions): We set up and manage secure cloud hosting on AWS, Google Cloud, and Vercel.
- [IoT & Connected Systems](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/iot-connected-systems): IoT system design and development for UAE businesses, connecting physical devices to cloud dashboards, automation workflows, and real-time monitoring.
- [API & Systems Integration](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/api-systems-integration): API development and systems integration for UAE businesses, connecting your tools, platforms, and databases into a single, coherent operational system.
- [Data Platforms & Dashboards](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/data-platforms-dashboards): Custom data platforms and business intelligence dashboards for UAE companies, turning raw data into clear, actionable insights.
- [AI-Assisted Production](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/ai-assisted-production): AI-assisted video and creative production pipelines designed to accelerate asset generation while maintaining premium studio quality.

### Infynix Media (Content, film and production)
Brand films, photography, motion graphics and short-form social content, produced in house.
- Hub: https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/infynix-media
- [Photography & Videography](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/photography-videography): Professional photography and videography services for UAE brands, product shoots, corporate headshots, brand campaigns, and commercial video production.
- [Short-Form & Social Content](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/short-form-social-content): High-impact short-form video content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn, produced and optimised for maximum reach and engagement.
- [Brand Films & Commercials](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/brand-films-commercials): Cinematic brand films and commercial video production for UAE businesses, from concept and scripting through to final broadcast-ready delivery.
- [Motion Graphics & Animation](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/motion-graphics-animation): Professional motion graphics and animation for UAE brands, explainer videos, animated logos, product demos, and 3D renders.
- [Podcast & Audio Production](https://www.infynixsolutions.ae/solutions/podcast-audio-production): End-to-end studio podcast recording, sound engineering, mastering, and multi-channel audio distribution.
